jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a top-level executive Director role leading the organisation through a senior team of three Deputy Directors with ultimate executive responsibility — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive senior leadership the candidate does not have. The subject matter is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level role at £52,088 (Project/Regional Lead/Manager band), plainly not entry-level and requiring substantial experience the candidate lacks; strategic litigation also implies legal expertise. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level Coordinator post, but it is a fundraising role that sits outside the candidate's research/policy strengths and matches none of their skills or interest zones. Only the human-rights employer lends any appeal; the fundraising function is a weak fit for this research-oriented profile.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% pension

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it is a volunteer/advisory expert position seeking established specialists (and effectively activists with lived regional experience), which the candidate does not match. Although the human-rights subject is on-mission, the role is neither paid nor entry-level, so it fails the genuine-paid-role gate.

jobs.title: Head of Peer Review Management
jobs.reason: "Head of" senior leadership role requiring proven experience leading complex projects, change initiatives and cross-functional teams — plainly not entry-level and beyond the candidate's student-assistant background. Publishing operations management also falls outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Freelance Podcast Director
jobs.reason: Not entry-level and a hard skills mismatch: the role demands an experienced content producer (broadcast journalist / Westminster researcher / think-tanker) with a track record of building podcasts and, essentially, an active trusted network across government, Whitehall and Westminster — none of which the candidate has. Although UK policy is adjacent to her interests, this is a specialist media-production freelance brief far outside her research-and-writing profile.
jobs.salary: Not specified (day rate to be proposed by applicant)

jobs.title: Senior Communications Consultant – German Media & Strategic Communications
jobs.reason: Ineligible on level — this is a mid-level-to-senior consultancy requiring "substantial experience in senior communications, press or public affairs roles in the German market," which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet, and it also asks for a proven track record the candidate lacks. Location is also a hard fail under "London only" (remote-Germany / Berlin, no London option). ISD's counter-extremism and information-operations mission is genuinely interesting, but the seniority and comms-specialist essentials block it.
jobs.location: Remote (Germany); occasional attendance at Berlin office
jobs.salary: Daily rate, commensurate with experience (candidate to state expected day rate)

jobs.title: AEP Lecturer in Public Policy and Ethics
jobs.reason: A Lecturer post carrying independent module planning, postgraduate supervision and subject research effectively requires a completed (or near-completed) PhD and academic teaching experience the candidate does not have — it is not an entry-level role. The public-policy/ethics area is of some interest, but the level is a hard mismatch.
jobs.salary: £45,031 to £52,514 per annum including London Allowance

jobs.title: Managing Editor
jobs.reason: The role asks for "solid experience of journal publishing workflows" — a specific operational publishing background the candidate lacks, though it is not framed as a strict years-based bar and only a bachelor's is required, so it stays eligible but is a weak paper fit. It is an editorial/project-management position outside the candidate's research and interest zones, and comms/administration is only a partial strength. Publishing is adjacent to the candidate's academic-publication experience, giving a mild interest pull but little core alignment.

jobs.title: Associate Tutor - Political Communications
jobs.reason: Explicitly a development post "ideally suited to a PhD researcher or someone at an early career stage," so it is on-level and eligible; the essential criterion is demonstrable knowledge of politics and political communication, which the candidate's IR background broadly covers, though HE teaching experience is only desirable and absent. Political communication is adjacent to the candidate's German foreign-policy-discourse and media interests but sits outside the core mission zones, and the very part-time, contingent-on-enrolment nature limits its pull.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director, Media Strategy & Communications
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — a Director-level title requiring 5–10 years of corporate communications experience, which the candidate plainly lacks. It is also a comms-specialist role outside the candidate's core interest zones and skill set.

jobs.title: Manager / Associate Director, Special Situations M&A
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Manager / Associate Director" title requiring substantial M&A / corporate finance advisory experience gained in professional services, consultancy or investment banking — well beyond entry-level and outside the candidate's skill set. Both the seniority and the specialist finance experience are unmet essentials, and the subject sits far from the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Associate Tutor in Politics
jobs.reason: This is genuine paid, entry-level teaching support requiring subject knowledge in social/political science and an appropriate qualification level — the candidate's MSc (in progress) and strong grades plausibly meet the "qualified to the corresponding level" bar, especially for the level-four undergraduate modules, though the PG "Global Politics, Governance and Security" module leans on teaching experience the candidate lacks. It touches the candidate's academic/policy interest zone but is a teaching rather than research role, and the requirement for prior undergraduate teaching experience is a real soft obstacle. Worth a look as a foot-in-the-door academic role in London.

jobs.title: Associate Tutor in Politics
jobs.reason: This is entry-level teaching work not requiring a completed PhD ("qualified to the corresponding level of the award... or equivalent"), which an MSc candidate with distinction-level marks and RA experience can plausibly meet, especially for the level-four undergraduate modules on political science and globalisation. However, the candidate has no prior teaching experience, which is emphasised throughout, and the topics (democracy theory, global governance) are adjacent rather than in the core mission — the postgraduate international-politics module is the closest fit. It sits in London and is a real paid contract, but teaching is a partial skills gap that limits winnability.

jobs.title: Associate Tutor - Political Communication
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly early-career development post ("ideally suited to a PhD researcher or someone at an early career stage") with the only essential being demonstrable knowledge of politics and political communication, so the candidate meets the bar on level, though HE teaching experience (desirable) is a gap. Political communication is adjacent to the candidate's German-foreign-policy and discourse interests but sits outside the core mission zones, and a single evening-teaching module is a modest, tangential opportunity rather than a research-track fit.

jobs.title: Communications and Marketing Officer, Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity
jobs.reason: This is an internal-applicant-only post ("This role is only open to internal LSE applications. Any external applications will not be considered."), and as a current MSc student the candidate would not qualify as internal staff. Beyond that, the role is a dedicated communications and marketing specialist post whose essential requirements (professional comms/marketing experience, social-media channel management, editorial and multimedia production, event management) fall squarely in the candidate's partial-gap area and lie outside the core interest zones. The social-equity theme is mildly adjacent but does not offset the eligibility bar.
jobs.salary: £36,513–£41,565 pa (progression to £44,468), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Business Support Advisor
jobs.reason: This is an administrative customer-support role (certificate processing, onboarding, SAP data entry) that offers no research or analytical content matching the candidate's profile, and it sits entirely outside all three interest zones. It is technically entry-level and eligible, but a poor fit on nearly every axis with no meaningful pull.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Datacenter Server Lifecycle
jobs.reason: This is a Staff-level engineering role requiring hands-on server hardware experience, deep datacenter operations background (8+ years preferred) and production-grade software/infrastructure skills far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. Both the seniority and the deep-technical essentials are hard disqualifiers, regardless of the AI-adjacent employer.

jobs.title: MHPSS Specialist (Team Leader)
jobs.reason: Location fails the London-only hard filter — the role is onsite in the West Bank with no London or remote option. It is also a "Team Leader" role in mental health / psychosocial support, requiring specialist MHPSS expertise the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title plus essential requirements for proven B2B marketing-campaign delivery and healthcare-communications experience place this clearly above entry-level and outside the candidate's limited marketing background. It is also a healthcare-marketing role with no connection to the candidate's research or interest areas.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.reason: Disqualified on level and language: the "Manager" title with "multiple/extensive years' experience" and a required excellent knowledge of a Central Asian local language (including Mongolian) are essential requirements the candidate cannot meet. Although the human-rights and grant-making mission is adjacent to the candidate's interests, this is a mid-career regional post far beyond an entry-level fit.

jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.reason: Requires an ACA/ACCA professional accounting qualification the candidate does not hold, plus two to three years of post-qualification experience — both unmet essentials. The role is also outside all interest zones and does not match the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Assistant Editor
jobs.reason: Entry-level with a bachelor's requirement met, and the candidate's writing, editorial and academic-publishing familiarity transfer partially — but the role emphasizes specific experience with manuscript-tracking systems, peer-review workflows and STEM publishing, which is a genuine skills gap. Academic publishing is only tangential to the candidate's core interest zones, so the interest pull is modest and the fit is workable but not compelling.

jobs.title: Head of Policy – Climate and Health
jobs.reason: A "Head of Policy" role requiring deep, long-standing expertise, senior-level influencing experience and a track record of managing matrix teams — plainly far beyond entry-level and a hard disqualifier for a candidate with only student-assistant experience. The climate-and-health policy field also sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an Advisory Committee — a voluntary/advisory position seeking established experts and activists from specific regions (East Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia), not a genuine paid entry-level role for the candidate. It is a talent/expert-panel call rather than a concrete salaried vacancy, which is disqualifying despite the human-rights subject matter.

jobs.title: Project Manager – IT Governance & Outsourcing
jobs.reason: This is a senior IT-governance project-management role requiring a proven project manager with change management, IT vendor management, budgets up to $5m and cross-functional IT system implementations — well beyond entry-level and outside the candidate's skill set. Neither the level nor the technical IT-delivery requirements are a fit, and the topic falls outside the candidate's interest zones.
